hero.eyebrow: BodyWork for Your Body and Being · Austin, TX / Online
hero.headline_line1: Your body doesn't need a smaller life.
hero.body: Bodywork that meets you where you are and moves you past what's been holding you back. Whatever the limitation or challenge.

cards.title: Hands-On Bodywork
cards.body: Direct physical contact that locates, releases to alters what's stuck. Structural, energetic, and intuitive — guided by what your body is aware of and asking for.

cards.title: Hands-Off Energy Work
cards.body: No touch required. Energetic bodywork work at a distance — online or in person — addressing limitations, challenges, or functional changes at the level where they originate.

cards.title: Classes & Group Work
cards.body: Group Classes to facilitate you working with your body. Movement, energy awareness, and nervous system tools to assist you in changing how your body functions, and maybe even upgrade it :)

about.label: About Matthew
about.title_line1: When your body is the center of your life,
about.body_1: I came to this work through my own body's demands. What I discovered is that limitations — physical, energetic, or mental — respond to the different types of contact. Sometimes that's hands-on. Sometimes it's hands-off. The approach follows what your system actually needs.
about.body_1b: What if your body needs you to expand the scope of your life, so it can flourish? It's asking you to expand it, not make it more defined. If you do this, your body's issues become less, and your life becomes more.
about.body_2: Sessions are available in Austin and online worldwide. Ready for something to point you in that direction?
about.quote: Your body doesn't need to be less in your life. It needs to be in a bigger life.

formats.label: How we can work together
formats.intro: Flexible for your rate of change.

items.title: In Person — Austin, TX
items.body: Sessions held in Austin at my office (possibility for home sessions per request). The most immersive way to work — in person bodywork in a quiet, undistracted setting designed to let your system fully land.

items.title: Online — Anywhere
items.body: Distance is not a barrier to change, it's just different. Online sessions are available worldwide for those outside Austin, or who prefer the convenience of home.

items.text: After one session with Matthew I slept better than I had in months. Something genuinely shifted that I hadn't been able to access through any other recovery method.
items.name: Runner, Austin Marathon

items.text: His classes are unlike anything I've done. I came for the physical recovery work and stayed for everything else it opened up.
items.name: Yoga teacher & performer

items.text: I was skeptical about online sessions but the work translated completely. The regulation I feel after our calls is real and lasting.
items.name: Cyclist, training remotely

cta.label: Ready to begin
cta.body: Bring all of your limitations, challenges, and questions — and let's see what's possible.
